title: Escudo de bits: la cúpula, parchearla y Redundancia
description: docs/animas/tecnopata/README.md § Virus atómico and Escudo de bits. In the fight tester against three sturdy dogs, one player leading both, with Cardioide and Redundancia bought. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); });

steps.caption: Escudo de bits: Bip throws its bits up over the party and they close as a dome; the dogs come up to it, not through it, and their blows land on its shell: Cúpula −N, nothing on Gerard or Aitor
The dome standing over both, its icon with the PV it has left on their plates

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const w = s.allies.find(a => a.bits)?.bits; if (w) w.hp = 12; })

steps.caption: The dome at 12 of its 40 PV: cracks run across it, dark gaps with bright lips, more and wider the more it has lost

Cardioide on Gerard, who is whole: the cure goes into the dome (Cúpula +N); every bit turns green and the dome breathes, swelling and settling, while its cracks close; with Redundancia it can go past its 40 PV
The dome patched: its PV on the plates, over 40 with Redundancia

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const w = s.allies.find(a => a.bits)?.bits; if (w) w.hp = 4; })

steps.caption: A dome with 4 PV left: the first dog's blow breaks it (¡Cúpula rota!), it gives way in chips from inside, and what it could not stop reaches whoever it was aimed at
After it broke: no dome, its icon gone from the plates
